tei:div.tei:p: na mo badzra pa ṇi ye/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /'dzin mdzad phyag na rdo rje'i sprul/ /rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras la/ /'dud kyis 'dod rgu'i mchog sbyin mdzod/ /'dir ston pa nyid kyi drung nas lan du mar 'jig rten skyong zhing bstan pa srung bar zhal gyi bzhes pa'i nor gyi bdag po rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas la mchod bstod ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa dgon sde 'di'i 'don tshul dang mthun par brjod par bya ste/ de yang rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi pho brang dang bcas pa'i sku sogs bkram/ mchod gtor sogs gzhung 'di nyid nas 'byung ba ltar grub na legs shing*/ min kyang ci 'grub bshams la/ bdag bskyed phyag rdor ram/ 'jigs byed gang byas kyang rung la/ mchod pa las sngags kyis bsangs/ /swa bhā was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi mig yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog ces sogs rgyud sde 'og ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rten bskyed pa ni/ a mṛ ta 'am/ hrīḥṣtīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du bhruṃ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa/ 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i dbus na khang bu brtsegs pa dgu yod pa'i dbus ma'i pho brang sum brtsegs su gnas pa'i rtse mor nor bu rin po che'i tog gis sbras pa/ logs rnams su dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing mda' yab pu shu dang ldan pa/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūrya/ nub padma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'i ka ba nyis stong lnga'i brgyas phyogs re nas brgyan pa/ gter gyi khang ba bco lnga dag gi spras pa de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ bum pa bzang po brgyad/ dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad/ rin po che'i ljon shing brgyad/

rdzing bu bzang po rin po che'i ljon shing me tog dang ldan pa brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba brgyad rnams spel mar gnas pa'i phyi rol nas rin po che'i rwa ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba/ pho brang dbus ma'i nang du hrīḥlas sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bai ser po las byung ba'i rgyal mtshan bais mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te bai la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing*/ g.yon rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i gter gyi ne'u 'dzin pa/ seng ge nyal ba la de nyid la blta ba'i steng nas sems dpa'i skyil mo dkrungs gis bzhugs pa/ zhal nas rin po che'i char 'bebs pas skye dgu thams cad phongs pa las sgrol zhing*/ dbu la rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas spras shing*/ phrag gong gnyis nas nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa/ nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ shar gyi khang brtsegs kyi nang du padma'i gdan la dzambha la ser po g.yas rin po che bsnams pa/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po g.yas bum bzang bsnams pa/ nub tu nor bu bzang po dgu tshig g.yas nor bu bsnams pa/ byang du ku be ra nag po g.yas ral gri bsnams pa/ shar lho'i yang dag shes ser po g.yas gser gri bsnams pa/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po g.yas rin po che'i mdung bsnams pa/ nub byang du lngas rtsen ser skya g.yas khang brtsegs bsnams pa/ byang shar du 'jam po 'khyil ba dkar po g.yas gri phub bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le bsnams pa/

rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la chibs shing rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid la rngams pa/ mi sdug pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor sa bar pa la gnod byin bye ba'i tshogs dang*/ 'khor sa tha ma la lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs srin po'i gzugs can drag tu khros shing rngams pa/ phyag g.yas na mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thams cad ne'u 'dzin pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po mgrin par a:dmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne la khro bo 'dod rgyal dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa spros pas/ byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig spyan drangs par bsams la/ sbyar spos bsregarol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ ༈ bai /sa 'dzin dbang po'i byang gi phyogs/ / rig sngags 'chang ba kun gyi gnas/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /nor gyi bdag po rnam thos sras/ /'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren na/ /rnal 'byor bdag la brtser dgongs la/ /thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying bas/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing*/ /gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod/ /thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /byang gi phyogs na bzhugs pa rnams/ /sems can don phyir gshegs su gosal/ /oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ye sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhuṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ bai swāha/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ye a karṣā ya dzaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ bai ring po brjid bag dang bcas pa mig 'dzum sum cu so gnyis kyi bar du brjod pas/ rgyal po'i thugs kar padma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab ma re rer/

bai bzhi bzhi bsam zhing*/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i thugs kar 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sprel bar bsam mo/ /de nas rin po che'i dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ratna mu ku tra a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i bsang gtor 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra prokṣa ṇaṃ pra tī tstsha ya āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du bsang gtong gi gnas su/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog sogs dang*/ prokṣa ṇaṃ gyi gnas su arghaṃ/ pādyaṃ/ añdza ma ṇaṃ/ puṣpe sogs sbyar nas rol mo'i bar du dbul/ rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang*/ /gter chen bum pa padma dang*/ /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u/ /mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i phyir/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wa ra aṣta maṃ ga la pū dza me gha sa mu tra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes pas bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*/ phun tshogs 'khor lo rin po che/ /dri med btsun mo khyim bdag dang*/ /cang shes rta dang theg chen glang*/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i/ /dmag dpon rin chen sna bdun rnams/ /bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /rgyal chen sras dang btsun mor bcas/ /'khor dang bcas pa bzhes su gsol/ /sabta ratna sogs kyis rin chen bdun 'bul/ /rab 'byams zhing na yid 'ong gzugs mdzes mchog /rnar snyan yid 'bab sgra snyan gang yod dang*/ /dri zhim ngad kyis stong gsum yongs gang zhing*/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i lha yi zhal zas dang*/ /'jams mnyen 'khril chags lha rdzas na bza'i tshogs/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin la 'gran pa bzhin/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la phul ba yis/ /'gro kun mi zad gter la longs spyod shog /oṃ bai= pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa pu dzi te āḥhūṃ gis 'dod yon lnga 'bul/

de nas yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ rgya chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing*/ /sprin bral nyi ma stong gi gzhi ldan pa/ /'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' khyab yid 'ong lha rdzas dngos kun dang*/ /bka' 'bangs bran slad rang lus nyer bsdogs bcas/ /ma chags mi zhum zab dang rgya che'i phyir/ / dgongs chen bsgrub phyir dge tshogs rgya mtshos mchod/ /rang gi rgyu sngon ma bsags 'bras 'dod dang*/ /don med don log cung zad don gyi phyir/ /ha cang 'dod chen bskyed dang chog mi shes/ /bsam sbyor nongs pa gang bgyis mthol lo bshags/ /lha klu mi rnams 'jigs dang phongs pa las/ /myur skyob 'jig rten skyong rgyal 'jig rten las/ /kun sgrol kun la phan dang bde ster ba/ / 'phrin las rgyun chad med la rjes yi rang*/ /sna tshogs ya nga 'jigs dang mgon med dang*/ /sdig sdug brel 'phongs brgyas gzir skal ngan rnams/ /dbugs dbyung slad du thugs gsung sku dang 'od/ /nyi zla ne'u le rgyal mtshan rnam rol bskul/ khyod sku khro dang 'dzum dang brjid mdzes 'gying*/ /sgeg dul brtan 'jigs dpa' bo'i gar dgu yis/ /mi bsrun tshar gcod skal ldan rjes bzung phyir/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bdag gsol 'debs/ /de ltar 'gro skyabs khyod la 'gro bde'i slad/ /lha mchog lhag pa'i lhar bzung bsnyen bkur bas/ /bdag sogs mgon med mgon mdzod rtag tu yang*/ /shes rab thugs rjes mi bsnel mi gtong shog /de nas yig brgya brjod cing bshags pa bya ba ni/ bai byang phyaugs skyong ba gser ltar mdzes pa'i sku/ /dri med nyi zla lta bu 'od zer 'phro/ /sgrub mchog skyong phyir rgyal mtshan ne'u le 'dzin/ /bstan bsrung gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /rgyal po khyod kyi sku gsung thugs dang ni/ / spang zhing blang ba'i dam tshig bsrung mtshams las/

/rnal 'byor mi brtson dbang gis 'das srid na/ /bzod pa bzhes shing bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /dang po spang bar bya ba'i dam tshig las/ /ro la 'jus shing ro gos gyon pa dang*/ rta nag zhon cing re nag bting ba dang*/ zhwa nag gos nag gyon pa mthol lo bshags/ /rta bong sha khrag zos shing 'thungs pa dang*/ /yug mos bcos pa'i kha zas zos pa dang*/ /gas shing chag pa'i snod du zos pa rnams/ /rgyal chen khyod kyi sku la bzod par gsol/ /dang du blang ba'i dam tshig las 'das te/ /bsnyen pa ma thengs gnad la bor ba dang*/ /sbyin pa ma btang 'dod chen nor blangs dang*/ /dus su mchod gtor ma byas bzod par gsol/ khyod kyi rten mchog 'chang bar dam bcas nas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten gsum ma rnyed dang*/ /rnyed kyang lus la ma bcings bral ba dang*/ /lung thang phreng bas ma bgrangs bzod par gsol/ /mdor na chos skyong khyod kyi dam tshig las/ /'ga' zhing nyams par gyur pa ci mchis pa/ /gnod sbyin khyod la bzod par gsol lags kyi/ /tshangs par bstsal nas grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /de nas bskang rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bskang rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas/ spyan gzigs/ mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyisabarlab cing*/ rgyas par byed na sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis kyang byin gyisabarlab bo/ /de nas rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ rin chen mang sprul rgyal po chen po ste/ bde mdzad srid gsum phongs dang rgud pa las/ /myur skyob bkra shis dpal 'bar bde ster ba/ /mgon po siddhi'i gter mchog thugs dam bskang*/

/thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su skongs gyur nas/ /bdag cag sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol/ /gos sngon lung thang phreng ba cang shes rta/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang gter bum dpag sam shing*/ /khrus kyi rdzing bu gtsug lag khang chen dang*/ /gsang chen bris sku dam pas thugs dam bskang = = /don dam spros bral skye 'gag gnas gsum bral/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang rgyal po chen po yang*/ /ting 'dzin 'ja' tshon lta bur dus kun spyod/ /lta sgom spyod pa zab mos= = /gsang sngags bsnyen bsgrub thun mong khyad par dang*/ /sku gsung thugs dang bye brag spyi rnams kyi/ / dam tshig gtsang ma'i dge ba ci mchis pa/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i= / rtag gtor rgyun gtor dus gtor gnyan po dang*/ /mchod pa lnga dang 'dod yon rnam lnga dang*/ /rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis/ /mgon po= nas 'bras gro sran til dang 'bru yi tshogs/ /dzā ti gur gum tsandan ga bur dang*/ /gla rtsi dri lnga 'bru sna lnga dang ni/ /byi dri sing dri ta si de ba dang*/ /kar ni kar dang sman mchog rnam lnga dang*/ /chu yi snying po lan tshwa rtsi thog dang*/ /shing tog bu ram brang rtsi til mar dang*/ /sman lnga snying po lnga yis thugs= /lus 'phags po dang 'dzam gling ba lang spyod/ /sgra mi snyan dang gling phran brgyad po dang*/ /nyi zla ri rab kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /mgon po 'khor dang = dngos grub stsol/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la 'dud/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang*/ /khyad par las bsgrub gnod sbyin brgyad/ /nor ster ba yi klu chen brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ / mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgra bgegs ma lus gzhom pa dang*/ /'byor ba'i longs spyod phun tshogs shing*/ /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/

/gzhan don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /de nas bzlog pa spyi ltar bya'am/ /ma byas kyang rung la/ mthun pa'i dngos grub mas dngos grub zhu bar bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa bsdu na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog /de'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par gyur par bsams ste/ gzungs ring ni/ tadya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e hye hi/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ sarba artha me sā dha ya/ tadya thā/ su dha ni/ su ra ge /su ma ti/ su su khe/ hi li mi li swāhā/ snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ye swāhā/ 'khor kyi snying po ni/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ purṇa bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ku be ra ye swāhā/ oṃ sumba dza na ye swāhā/ oṃ gu hya ha na ye swāhā/ oṃ pañtsi ka ye swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇḍa li ye swāhā/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni/ gzungs ring ci 'grub dang*/ gtso bo'i sngags rab 'bum phrag bzhi bcu'am/ ma mthar sum 'bum bzla zhing 'khor rnams la ni khri phrag re bzla'o/ /mthar yig brgya bzlas nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas grub pa'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/

rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse gcig pa 'od kyi spu gu can du gyur par bsams la/ gzhan yang 'byung ba ltar ram/ bsdu na/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ye swāhā/ i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun dang*/ oṃ dzambha la dza lent+ra ye sāhā/ zhes pa nas/ bai tsa kuṇḍa li sa pa ri wā ra i dam pa ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ 'khor gzhan la a kā ro lan gsum gyis phul nas 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūṃ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes nas kyang*/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /bu sdug bzhin du rtag tu bskyang bar mdzod/ /bdag la gnod par sems pa yi/ /log par zhugs pa'i sems can rnams/ /de yi phru ma gzhom pa dang*/ /gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che mnga' ba'i/ /gnod sbyin bdag po khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam pa ma lus pa/ /myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ hūṃ rin chen dam pa'i pho brang nas/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams/ /sku mdog gser gyi 'od las mdzes/ /zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs/ /thugs rjes phongs pa las sgrol mdzad/ /sku la rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /byang phyogs rgyal bor sku yang sprul/ /rnam thos sras su mtshan yang grags/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu la rin chen cod pan gsol/ /yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /sde po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par mdzad/ /stobs po che la= bum pa bzang pos rnam par brgyan/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*/ /rdzing bu bzang dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang yang na de'i mjug tu/ dpag med dus nas sangs rgyas kyang*/ /rgyun zhugs sa brgyad dbang phyug sogs/ /gang mtshams du ma'i rnam rol gyis/ /re ba bskong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ces sbyar na'ang legs so/ /bai dzambha la ni gser gyi mdog /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na/ /rin chen bsnams la= /gang ba bzang po sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta yi= g.yon pa ne'u le= bum pa bsnams= nor bu bzang po sku mdog dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul= g.yon pa= nor bu= ku be ra ni sku mdog nag /rdzu 'phrul rta yi= g.yon pa ne'u= ral gri bsnams la= yang dag shes ni sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa ne'u le= gser gri bsnams la= 'brog gnas sku mdog nag po la/ rdzu 'phrul= g.yon pa= mdung dmar bsnams la= lngas rtsen sku mdog ser skya la/ /rdzu 'phrul rta yi= g.yon pa ne'u le= khang brtsegs bsnams la= pi tsi kuṇḍa li ni dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na/ gri phub 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /mdog mi sdug pa sna tshogs te/ /g.yon pa thams cad ne'u dang*/ /g.yas na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin/ /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ khams gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus/ khyod ni nor bdag chen po ste/ /nor bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod rnams mchod cing gsol btab pas/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i phyogs zhing zhing*/ /mthun rkyen 'dod pa'i dngos grub rnams/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /ces bstod cing 'phrin las bcol lo/
/ ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis gzhan la phan ched co ne dgon nyid du bsgrigs nas par du brkos so// //maṅgalaṃ//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ rnam sras mngon rtogs bzhugs/ - PAGE 224-- PAGE 225- -PAGE 214-
